scope: The twelve Mech source revisions from the October 7, 2026 refresh are retained. CMMMech is added at 905388523b6e9184783989484896e4cc20297832, committed October 8, with its own pinned_at_utc. The common vocabulary census, overlap assets, heatmap record lists and record statistics are regenerated over all thirteen pinned corpora. CELEX and additional registry spellings found while adding CMMMech and the kg-microbe comparison are counted consistently across every corpus. Card figures for the original twelve are retained and rechecked against their pinned sources and live sites. Merged-PR totals are all-time GitHub counts queried during this addition, across thirteen Mechs, CLAW and this website. The separately versioned kg-microbe core release comparison is recorded in kg_microbe_census.json and does not enter Mech totals or shared-term graph indexes. The website feature baseline and existing rechecks are retained; CMMMech has no published website. CLAW membership and capability declarations come from 7e6c3eec34c203a74736c715e8eaebf7e60cd329. Declarations describe shared contract adoption rather than native scientific validation coverage.

notes.AntibioticMech: 2,939 data/antibiotics records at the pin, equal to the published stat tile: 2,669 ontology-grounded and 270 minted. The README and unchanged corpus contain 80 REVIEWED, 30 PROPOSED and 2,829 SEEDED records, 454 with a mode of action and 282 with a molecular target.
notes.CellStructureMech: 906 data/structures records at the pin, equal to the stat tile: 13 categories, 758 GO-grounded, 148 minted and 214 membrane organelles. All 906 are PROPOSED. The generated README and corpus contain 743 records with components and 848 with causal graphs (878 individual graphs and 3,755 evidence-backed edges); 71 records have imaging data.
notes.CommunityMech: The published landing tile counts 456 kb/communities records. Four additional data/isolates records make the common census and repository-statistics total 460. The landing category tile now agrees with the schema enum and browser facet: 15 categories. Embedding maps are separate derived artifacts and can cover fewer records.
notes.CultureMech: The committed README and app/index.html both state 15,910 normalized and 6,320 merged records, matching the corpus directories at the pin. The card checker retains the README corpus snapshot as its count source. docs/DATA_LAYERS.md documents GitHub Actions publishing for the generated browser assets and checks both README and landing-page counts against the corpus. Five category directories are populated. MediaIngredientMech links occur in 5,700 merged recipes and 70,448 of 100,448 ingredient rows (70.1%). Browser evidence and CommunityMech provenance links have improved without changing these corpus totals.
notes.HabitatMech: 3,207 data/habitats records at the pin, equal to the stat tiles: 691 REVIEWED, 2,516 SEEDED and 2,151 ontology-grounded. REVIEWED is a recorded status, not proof of human review. The README and corpus contain 176 records attested by at least two sources.
notes.MediaIngredientMech: The pinned records and checked data/ingredients.json index contain 2,953 ingredients: 2,611 MAPPED, 260 UNMAPPED, 81 REJECTED and 1 AMBIGUOUS (88% mapped after rounding). The record total and status distribution are unchanged. Ingredient evidence and specific CultureMech recipe links are now rendered in the browser. Browser metadata uses directory placement instead of status for the separate mapped/unmapped file totals.
notes.NaturalProductMech: 3,115 natural product structures at the pin, matching the landing prose. The README and page report 3,407 producer claims, 808 supported by evidence addressing the organism, and 2,342 records with cited occurrences. The corpus has 157 records describing biosynthetic pathways. Resolving the pinned causal_graph_refs gives 240 graph-bearing records and 567 individual graphs: 408 inline graphs plus 159 referenced components. Every referenced component matches its owner's record ID and InChIKey. The vocabulary census retains its existing owner-record globs and does not separately scan these component files.
notes.ProteinTraitsMech: 429,293 records and 34 browser source labels, matching both the static landing counts and runtime data/facets.json. The source-label fallback manual groups several imported sources; it is not a distinct evidence source. The retained corpus map covers 344,797 current records, with 84,496 outside that snapshot. The protein map covers 68,657 Swiss-Prot proteins and the sequence map covers 12,705; these derived views are distinct from the complete record browser.
notes.TaxonMech: 625,960 species-level and infraspecific data/taxa records at the pin, equal to the landing tile. The site lists 100,745 distinct strains, 20,648 taxa with a type strain and 21,071 listed strains with genome identifiers. Higher taxa are carried in lineage fields rather than counted as standalone records. The canonical taxon tree and README statistics are unchanged; browser rendering and filters have advanced.
notes.TraitMech: 1,059 data/traits records at the pin, equal to the pinned landing tile: 427 REVIEWED, 544 PROPOSED, 50 DEPRECATED and 38 SEEDED. The README and corpus contain 718 records with causal graphs. The pinned page shows 10 populated categories and 45.0% embedded (477 of 1,059). The live browser advanced to 1,060 during the feature audit; the card and common census retain their original pin.
notes.PathwayMech: 156 data/pathways records at the pin and 156 links in the published record browser. They contain 7,307 mechanistic edges across 16 taxa, with 1,203 distinct reference IDs. Record pages distinguish 8,183 structured source assertions from 63 quoted evidence items. Current committed outputs include KGX nodes/edges and SSSOM source mappings; availability does not establish kg-microbe ingestion. The optional curation_history schema retains its explicit TaxonMech CurationEvent reference; 88 YAML records contain 110 inline events, while all 156 published pages additionally show separate canonical history. PathwayMech is measured by the common census, subset and statistics pipeline.
notes.DUFMech: 6,532 seed families in data/worklists/interpro-pfam-duf-2026-10-05.json, validated against its frozen manifest: 6,154 UNKNOWN_CANDIDATE and 378 KNOWN_HISTORICAL_DUF. These corrected classifications use the original frozen metadata, not a fresh InterPro retrieval. Each JSON row is one measured family; the TSV is a redundant serialization. Counts, heatmap occurrences and shared-term links continue to measure this seed worklist. Native FamilyRecords now have a LinkML schema and public family pages with evidence, curation history and specific cross-Mech leads, but all families remain UNSCORED. All 6,532 measured Pfam IDs have native page routes. The seed worklist has no review-status field, so the statistics do not infer zero reviewed from the separate native schema. A retained cross-Mech manifest records 16,298 imported evidence-lead rows from seven siblings at its own acquisition pins, distinguishing direct identities, text mentions and protein associations. These leads do not validate a family's function. CLAW now declares DUFMech as a member.
notes.culturebotai-claw: The 7e6c3ee canonical snapshot declares thirteen members, including CMMMech, twenty governed artifacts and twenty-six capabilities per member. CMMMech has native schema validation and curation history, while the corresponding shared fleet contracts remain explicitly disabled with reasons preserved verbatim. This membership update is independent of the retained October 7 source revisions for the original twelve Mechs and the website feature audits.
notes.CMMMech: Three canonical data/records material records: cobalt, neodymium and palladium, each with ChEBI element identity; two also carry NCBITaxon organism identifiers. Source citations, assay context, limitations, scientific review artifacts and append-only curation history are committed. The LinkML CriticalMineralRecord schema and native strict validator exist, but there is no top-level REVIEWED-bearing status slot, so review-status statistics remain null. Counts come from the complete Git tree inventory of data/records YAML files, excluding tests and review artifacts. The card and record links point to the repository because no public website is deployed. The pin contains CC BY 4.0 project-data and BSD-3-Clause code licenses, retaining upstream terms.
